title: Harden live-state and rules-record schemas
description:
Reduce reliance on opaque JSON blobs and unknown payloads where the data is central to gameplay.

This should coordinate with the rules-pack ingestion epic. Rules records need kind-specific schemas, and live gameplay entities should have stronger validation where they are frequently queried or mutated.
acceptance_criteria:
- RulesRecord data has kind-specific validation or schema path.
- Live gameplay JSON fields have typed codecs or validators where practical.
- Schema validation failures are test-covered.
- Generated/trace/archive JSON remains allowed where appropriate.
- The line between live queryable state and archival/generated blobs is documented.
close_reason: Implemented: new liveStateSchema.ts with validateAbilityScoresJson/validateConditionsJson/validateInventoryPropertiesJson + LiveStateSchemaError; wired into mutateState (shaped-json variant) and contextAssembler read boundary; boundary comment added to schema.ts; full test coverage in liveStateSchema.test.ts; all gates pass.
